title: Supreme Luxury for Discerning Tastes
description:
“AS SEEN ON CBS STAYCATION!”
Extraordinary property for discerning tastes,  as seen on Staycation!
Upscale everything. Massive rooms (6 En suite). Heated pool* and hot tub. Outdoor gardens. Huge Theatre. Gym with high end equipment. True Golf Simulator. 9 bedrooms, 10 baths. Luxurious in every way, yet warm and family oriented. Hosts and Boasts FUN!  On 3 acres.  Bring your family or close friends to make memories and connections that will last a lifetime.

The space
Unique and Rare French Country Inspired Estate. Private setting near Warner Parks…4 bedrooms on the main level, in-law suite on lower level with 2nd kitchen. Endless possibilities for fun and making connections!

We offer unmatched concierge services, where Kaitlin can arrange outings (tours/ roof top bars, Vineyard/Winery, etc.), a chef to come in to prepare meals, an acoustic concert, flower arrangements or whatever you can imagine that would make your trip over the top delightful… available upon booking…

(*There is an additional fee for heating the pool.)

Guest access
Guests enjoy the entire home and a 3 acre yard!

Other things to note
Pool towels provided and shampoos and conditioners. Hair dryer in each bathroom.
